title: Self-Generated Benchmark Factory — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Creates new evaluation tasks to expose weaknesses that existing tests miss. When current tests all pass but weaknesses are suspected, the factory invents new tasks aimed at the gaps — then measures what they expose. Framing: "God Mode" here means an ambitious engineering target — maximum useful capability, broad interoperability, deep automation, and rigorous verification — NOT unlimited intelligence or guaranteed success. "Boundless" means the capacity to extend this system, not a claim that its records or capabilities are already infinite. Record counts reported are actual populated counts; generated records are labeled "generated" and never mixed with sourced facts.
